statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail holds 20% at the floor of the watch band while Stress eases to 78% as the crude impulse fades.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is WATCH for NQ_FUTURES and NAS100_CFD. Tail remains at the bottom of the watch band: roughly 65% of the intraday range has been retraced, WTI is back to flat on the day and VIX has come off its high, so no persistent one-way structure is observed. One narrow danger window is flagged for 14:00-15:00Z on Sep 29, when JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence print together and the forecast maps to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds a deep retracement as the crude impulse fades to flat; Tail stays at the watch-band floor with Stress easing to high
body: As of the 17:00Z clock-hour the Nasdaq-100 trades at 30,341.85, down 266.28 points or 0.87%, after a gap-down open at 30,426.63 from Friday's 30,608.13 close. The session low of 30,081.06 has not been retested for several hours and the index holds roughly 65% of the 30,081.06-30,480.40 intraday range back from that low, so retracement is deep rather than shallow and repeated extension after failed pullbacks has not been observed. NQ futures trade 30,671.50, down 0.70%, about 314 points above their 30,357.75 low and roughly 56% back up their 30,357.75-30,920.75 range. The energy impulse that drove the early risk-off has now faded to nothing on the front WTI contract: WTI is $92.41, unchanged on the day against about 3% higher earlier in the session, and Brent is $105.07, up 0.72% against roughly 4% earlier, after Saudi East-West pipeline shipments resumed, even though President Trump rejected Iran's seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran held its conditions. VIX is 16.02, up 7.73% from 14.87 but below its 16.62 session high and a low absolute level. Rates remain the unresolved stress source: the 10-year yield is 5.23% against a 5.18% prior close, off its 5.27% high, with the curve reported up about six basis points. Internals stay dispersed rather than uniformly weak: Nvidia is higher after authorising a record $150 billion buyback increase, against a deep semiconductor selloff in ARM, Qualcomm and Marvell that traces to the OpenAI decision to pause training of its most capable models. Shared Finviz context collected at 14:34Z is both partial, with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, and older than the 90-minute freshness threshold at this assessment time; its latest-session breadth, megacap and semiconductor sections are labelled non-real-time and were used only as weak confirming context showing broad sector weakness with high semiconductor dispersion. Taken together this reads as an orderly, dispersion-driven drawdown that is actively mean-reverting inside a high-yield regime with a decaying energy amplifier, which holds Tail at 20% with Stress at 78% and Confidence at 88%.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours ran from a calm late-Friday regime with Tail near 8-14% into an overnight repricing that lifted Tail into the 21-24% watch band from the 03:00Z hour onward, while Stress climbed from 69% to the mid-80s. Two hours printed in the elevated band: 09:00Z at 26% during the European morning as crude extended, and 14:00Z at 27% as the US cash session traded down toward its low. The last two hours eased back to 23% and 20% as the index recovered and crude gave up most of its gain. Confidence improved steadily from 78% to 88% as live price-path and cross-asset evidence accumulated. Historical entries are the values published at the time and are not restated with later information.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the watch band through the remainder of the US cash session, with the 19:00Z power hour the highest slot at 23% on an unfilled gap-down day. After the 20:00Z close the conditional path eases into the low band through the post-close and Asian hours, on the explicit assumption that no fresh US-Iran or Strait of Hormuz headline arrives, while Stress stays high on the $105 Brent and 5.23% yield backdrop. The watch band returns from 08:00Z as European cash hours transmit the rate move, and the single elevated slot falls at 14:00Z on Sep 29, when JOLTS and CB Consumer Confidence both print inside the first half hour of US cash trade. Forecast values are conditional risk, not an assertion that future price structure has been observed.
